records.text: Charlie Kirk said Lyndon Baines Johnson, parts of the U.S. government, and Cubans wanted JFK dead.
records.speaker: Charlie Kirk

appearances.snippet: But definitely, Lyndon Baines Johnson and parts of our own government and the Cubans wanted him dead.

verification.notes: Transcript context confirms Kirk made the accusation. Current authoritative records do not substantiate that Lyndon Johnson, parts of the U.S. government, and Cubans wanted Kennedy dead. The House committee found no institutional involvement by the Secret Service, FBI, or CIA and found that the Cuban government was not involved, while leaving open only the possibility that unidentified individual anti-Castro Cubans may have participated. Those findings do not establish personal intent by Johnson or the broad groups named, so the allegation cannot be resolved conclusively.

sources.title: House Select Committee on Assassinations Findings on Conspiracy
sources.relevance: Official findings reject institutional U.S. and Cuban-government involvement while leaving limited individual possibilities open.

records.text: Charlie Kirk said the U.S. government had lied about the JFK assassination.
records.speaker: Charlie Kirk

appearances.snippet: Once we acknowledge that more than one person did it, then we can expose our government to have lied to us about the JFK assassination

verification.notes: Official reviews document serious shortcomings: the House committee found the conspiracy investigation inadequate, CIA information-sharing deficient, and official conclusions presented too definitively; the Assassination Records Review Board said secrecy damaged agency credibility. But the House committee also said the investigative conclusions were reached in good faith and found no official U.S. agency involvement in the assassination. The records support failures, omissions, and excessive certainty, but not the broad conclusion that the government deliberately lied about the assassination.

sources.title: House Select Committee on Assassinations Findings on Government Performance
sources.relevance: Documents investigative deficiencies, information-sharing failures, good-faith conclusions, and overstatement.

sources.title: Assassination Records Review Board Final Report
sources.relevance: Documents prolonged secrecy and its effect on public confidence without establishing a government assassination lie.

records.text: Owens said Qatar stated that it had a relationship with Hamas because the U.S. government had asked it to establish one.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And they said, the reason why we have a relationship with Hamas is because the U.S. government asked us to establish one.

verification.notes: Qatar's Ministry of Foreign Affairs reports that the prime minister said Qatar's relationship with Hamas was established 13 years earlier at the request of the United States. An earlier CBS interview also records him saying the Hamas office was established in coordination with the United States to maintain communication. These primary and direct sources verify Owens's summary of what Qatar stated; they do not imply U.S. endorsement of Hamas's actions.

sources.title: Face the Nation transcript: Qatari Prime Minister Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani
sources.relevance: Direct transcript says the Hamas office was established in coordination with the United States for communication.

records.text: A second videographer told Owens that authorities likewise had never contacted him.

appearances.snippet: Now I'll tell you what else I discovered, because a lot is going on, and we similarly, by the way, reached out to the person who shot the footage and said, "Somebody is on the roof." ... We spoke about that earlier this week. He told us the exact same thing.

verification.notes: Owens claims she contacted a witness who filmed video of the Charlie Kirk shooter and that the witness said neither federal nor local police had contacted him. However, this is an unverified secondhand account. Multiple sources confirm that FBI and local authorities conducted extensive witness interviews after the assassination. News reports indicate 'thousands of students' were present and prosecutors noted the process to identify witnesses could be laborious. Without identifying the specific witness or independent confirmation, this claim cannot be verified. Sources: https://www.cnn.com/2025/09/29/us/tyler-robinson-charlie-kirk-court, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Assassination_of_Charlie_Kirk
